senses.definition: n.pr.m. (I have asked (him) of God; on acc. cf. (late) ψ 137:3);—first son of Jehoiachin and uncle of Zerubbabel according to 1 Ch 3:17 (cf. v 18, 19); but Z.’s father Hg 1:1; 2:23; Ez 3:2, 8; Ne 12:1 (attempts at explan. in Be Kit Benz).—Σαλαθιηλ.
